// diagnostic

E-ERR-PROPAGATE

A bare `?` has no meaning.

What

A bare `?` has no meaning.

Why

Fallible calls propagate automatically; `?(text)` adds one failure-context frame.

Fix

Remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-ERR-PROPAGATE: tests/ui/build_locked_drift.stderr.

  6 |     }?
    |      ^
 Why: Fallible calls propagate automatically; `?(text)` is reserved for adding one failure-context frame.
 Fix: Remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.
